identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-01][readiness] Reconcile plans, sprint umbrellas, and parallel execution

values.task_boundary: Reconcile and prove v0.91.8 readiness only; do not execute downstream implementation.
deliverables: reviewed execution-readiness report and reconciliation matrix
parallel session assignment and dependency map
ready or not-ready disposition for every sprint
bounded repairs to stale planning, routing, ownership, and readiness truth
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Live issue and PR inventory is reconciled with every canonical v0.91.8 planning, feature, handoff, review, and release document
AC-2: Every sprint umbrella exists with a complete non-overlapping child set, dependencies, and terminal acceptance criteria
AC-3: Every issue has truthful ownership, version, dependency, card, design, validation, and readiness disposition
AC-4: Parallel lanes have disjoint write scopes or explicit stack order, a four-writer cap, and one integration queue
AC-5: Runtime v3 parity, multi-agent work, acceptance, external shadows, cutover, and release-tail work are routed without duplication or scope expansion
AC-6: Focused docs, structured-data, links, issue-routing, dependency, protected-path, and diff validation passes
dependencies: current v0.91.8 planning package and live issue inventory
repo_inputs: typed C-SDLC issue projections and session ledger
non_goals: product, Runtime, C-SDLC, demo, Observatory, or infrastructure implementation
new feature scope or one issue per finding
